title: Aerospace Engineering Design II
description: Second semester of a senior capstone sequence for students interested in aerospace engineering focused on system-level integration, manufacturability, and launch readiness of aerospace systems. Students carry forward validated prototypes from Design I and advance them through pre-production and manufacturing sprints. Final deliverables include system demonstrations, validation reports, go-to-market strategies, and public-facing showcase materials. Students will adhere to appropriate engineering codes and standards and incorporate realistic design and manufacturing constraints
